blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in visual perception and spatial reasoning, leading to growing interest in using them as high-level planners for embodied AI. However, physical tasks require models to integrate spatial information, reason over temporal states, and generate multi-step plans under various constraints, raising the question of whether current VLMs can reliably support such reasoning and planning independently of execution. We introduce Plan-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating the high-level reasoning and multi-step planning capabilities of VLMs relevant to embodied worlds, while isolating the influence of action execution. It covers three complementary dimensions, spanning 16 subclasses and 699 curated samples. Extensive evaluation of 28 VLMs reveals room for improvement, with even the strongest model achieving only 75.0% accuracy. We further find that model scaling generally improves these capabilities. Ablation studies also indicate larger models show increasing potential as high-level planners. Overall, Plan-Bench provides a lightweight probe for evaluating VLMs' reasoning and planning capabilities relevant to embodied environments and assessing their potential as decision makers for physical tasks. Our benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/MinneFeng/Plan-Bench.
blocks.zh: Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)在视觉感知和空间推理上取得了很强的性能,导致人们越来越有兴趣将其用作体现AI的高级规划者. 然而,物理任务需要模型来整合空间信息,理性超时状态,并在各种限制下产生多步骤计划,这就提出了当前VLM能否可靠地支持这种推理和规划而独立于执行的问题. 我们提出Bench计划,作为评估与所体现世界相关的自愿活动高级别推理和多步骤规划能力的基准,同时隔离行动执行的影响。 它涵盖三个相辅相成的层面,包括16个子类和699个整理样本。 对28个VLM的广泛评价表明,还有改进的余地,即使是最强的模型也只有75.0%的准确度。 我们进一步发现,这种模型的扩大总体上提高了这些能力。 校正研究还表明,作为高级规划人员,较大的模型显示出越来越大的潜力。 总体而言,Bench计划提供了一个轻量级的探测器,用于评价与所体现环境有关的脆弱LM的推理和规划能力,并评估其作为实际任务的决策者的潜力。 我们的基准和代码见https://github.com/MinneFeng/Plan-Bench。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) ( OpenAI, 2026 , Qwen Team, 2026a , Diao et al., 2026d , Diao et al., 2026b ) have substantially strengthened their capabilities in visual perception and spatial reasoning, leading to growing interest in using them as high-level planners for embodied AI ( Zhang et al., 2026 , Liu et al., 2026 , Yang et al., 2026 ) , particularly in complex physical tasks.
In such settings, models often need to integrate spatial information, reason over evolving temporal states, and generate multi-step plans under various constraints.
These demands expose an important and underexplored challenge: can existing VLMs go well beyond perception to reason and plan in embodied worlds?
blocks.zh:
最近视觉语言模型(VLMs)(OpenAI,2026年,Quen Team,2026年a,Diao等人,2026年d,Diao等人,2026年b)的进步,大大加强了他们在视觉认知和空间推理方面的能力,导致人们越来越有兴趣将其用作体现的AI(张等人,2026年,刘等人,2026年,杨等人,2026年)的高级别规划者,特别是在复杂的物理任务中.
在这种情况下,模型往往需要综合空间信息、理性而不是不断变化的时态,并在各种限制下产生多步骤计划。
这些要求暴露了一个重要的和未得到充分探讨的挑战:现有的自愿终止措施能否远远超出认知,而超越在所体现世界中理性和规划?

blocks.en:
Notably, existing benchmarks have not evaluated these capabilities of VLMs for embodied tasks.
As shown in Figure 1 , multimodal reasoning benchmarks ( Fu et al., 2026 , Yao et al., 2026 ) primarily focus on visual information.
Embodied benchmarks ( Fan et al., 2026 , Han et al., 2026 ) mainly evaluate embodied tasks, mixing errors from decisions and execution.
LongAct ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) attempts to reduce the influence of control and better assess decision making, but evaluates agents rather than VLMs.
It therefore remains unclear whether VLMs can perform reliable reasoning and planning in embodied scenarios when high-level decisions are separated from low-level execution.
blocks.zh:
值得注意的是,现有基准没有评估自愿任务组的这些能力,以完成具体的任务。
如图1所示,多式联运推理基准(Fu等人,2026年;姚等人,2026年)主要侧重于视觉信息.
健全的基准(Fan等人,2026年;Han等人,2026年)主要评价包含的任务,混合了决定和执行的错误.
LongAct(Zhu et al., 2026)试图减少控制的影响,更好地评估决策,但评价剂而不是VLM.
因此,当高级别决定与低级执行分开时,自愿多数派是否能够在包含的情景中进行可靠的推理和规划,这一点仍不清楚。

blocks.en:
To bridge this gap, we introduce Plan-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate VLMs’ high-level reasoning and multi-step planning relevant to embodied tasks.
As illustrated on the right side of Figure 1 , Plan-Bench systematically covers three dimensions: Spatial Cognition, Temporal Reasoning, and Multi-Step Planning, spanning 16 subclasses and 699 samples.
It is constructed through a three-stage pipeline consisting of task definition, dual-source visual data acquisition, and manual QA construction with quality assurance, resulting in a diverse and carefully curated benchmark dataset.
Plan-Bench includes both single-choice and open-ended questions, and provides answer hints for samples with multiple valid answers to guide more reliable LLM-as-judge evaluation.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了Bench计划,这是一个旨在评估VLM的高层次推理和与包含的任务有关的多步骤规划的基准。
如图1右侧所示,Bench计划系统涵盖三个层面:空间认知、时间理性和多步骤规划,涉及16个子类和699个样本。
该系统通过三阶段管道建造,包括任务定义、双源视觉数据采集和质量保证的人工质量保证建设,从而形成多样化和精心设计的基准数据集。
Plan-Bench既包括单选问题,也包括开放式问题,为有多个有效答案的样本提供解答提示,以指导更可靠的LLM-as-judge评价.

blocks.en:
We evaluate Plan-Bench on 28 VLMs.
The results show that current VLMs remain limited in reasoning and planning for embodied scenarios.
The best-performing model, Qwen3.8-Max ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) , achieves only 75.0%.
We further observe that performance generally improves with model scaling, with some variation across model families.
Our ablation studies show that larger models exhibit greater potential as high-level planners.
Overall, Plan-Bench provides a principled testbed for evaluating reasoning and planning in VLMs and a lightweight framework for assessing their potential as high-level embodied planners.
Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • Designing a reasoning and planning benchmark for VLMs in embodied worlds. Plan-Bench is an easy-to-deploy benchmark spanning 16 subclasses and 699 samples, enabling direct evaluation of VLMs’ high-level capabilities independently of low-level execution. • Providing a comprehensive evaluation of existing VLMs. We benchmark 28 representative VLMs and reveal their capabilities in high-level reasoning and multi-step planning. • Revealing current limitations and potential. Evaluation across proprietary and open-source models shows that reasoning and planning in embodied scenarios remain challenging, while larger models exhibit greater potential as high-level planners for embodied tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们用28VLM来评估Bench计划
结果显示,目前的自愿终止措施在对各种设想的推理和规划方面仍然有限。
表现最好的模式是Qwen3.8-Max(Quen Team,2026a),只实现了75.0%.
我们进一步注意到,业绩一般随着模型的扩大而改善,示范家庭之间也有一些差异。
我们的审阅研究表明,较大的模型显示出作为高级别规划者的更大潜力。
总而言之,Bench计划为评价自愿活动清单的推理和规划提供了一个原则性的试验床,并为评估其作为高级别规划者的潜力提供了一个轻量级框架。
我们的主要贡献概述如下: · 在所体现世界中设计一个虚拟LM的推理和规划基准。 Plan-Bench是一个易于部署的基准,涵盖16个子类和699个样本,能够独立于低级执行而直接评价VLMs的高级能力. • 全面评价现有自愿终止措施。 我们以28个具有代表性的甚高频谱作为基准,并揭示其在高级别推理和多步骤规划方面的能力。 • 揭示目前的局限性和潜力。 跨专有和开放源码模式的评价表明,在各种设想情况下的推理和规划仍然具有挑战性,而较大的模型则表现出更大的潜力,成为执行所包含任务的高级规划者。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multimodal Reasoning Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.1 多式联运理由基准

blocks.en:
Existing benchmarks have gradually evolved from perception toward complex reasoning.
MME ( Fu et al., 2026 ) evaluates both perceptual and cognitive abilities, while LENS ( Yao et al., 2026 ) organizes multimodal evaluation from understanding to reasoning.
Recent benchmarks such as VisuLogic ( Xu et al., 2026b ) , MIRA ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , and PuzzleWorld ( Li et al., 2026a ) further explore chain-of-thought and open-ended multi-step reasoning.
Beyond single-image reasoning, MuirBench ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , MMIU ( Meng et al., 2025 ) , EgoPlan-Bench2 ( Qiu et al., 2026 ) , among others ( Li et al., 2026b , Meng et al., 2025 ) extend evaluation to multiple images or frames, covering temporal changes and long-range visual evidence.
These benchmarks broaden the scope and complexity of multimodal reasoning.
However, existing benchmarks rarely target the reasoning and planning demands of embodied worlds.
Plan-Bench addresses this gap by evaluating these capabilities across Spatial Cognition, Temporal Reasoning, and Multi-step Planning.
blocks.zh:
现有基准逐渐从观念发展到复杂的推理。
MME(Fu等人,2026年)同时评价知觉能力和认知能力,而LENS(姚等人,2026年)则组织从理解到推理的多式联运评价.
近期的基准如VisuLogic(徐等人,2026b),MIRA(周等人,2026),和PizzleWorld(李等人,2026a)进一步探索了思想链和开放式的多步骤推理.
除了单像推理之外,Muir Bench(Wang等人,2025a),MMIU(Meng等人,2025),Ego 计划-奔驰2 (邱 et等,2026). (Li等人,2026b,Meng等人,2025年)将评价扩展到多个图像或帧,涵盖时间变化和远程视觉证据.
这些基准扩大了多式联运推理的范围和复杂性。
然而,现有的基准很少针对所体现世界的推理和规划需求。
Plan-Bench通过在空间认知、时间理性和多步骤规划中评估这些能力来解决这一差距。

blocks.en: 2.2 Multi-Step Tasks in Embodied Environments
blocks.zh: 2.2 健全环境中的多步骤任务

blocks.en:
Recent embodied systems increasingly employ VLMs ( Diao et al., 2024 , Diao et al., ) as decision makers.
Harness VLA ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , Goal2Skill ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , and HiVLA ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , among others ( Shi et al., 2025 , Li et al., 2025 , Yang et al., 2025c ) , adopt hierarchical frameworks that separate high-level reasoning and planning from low-level execution.
Meanwhile, several benchmarks have begun to evaluate these capabilities in embodied settings.
EmbodiedBench ( Yang et al., 2025b ) and RoboCerebra ( Han et al., 2026 ) evaluate embodied agents through interactive tasks or hierarchical VLM-VLA systems, where performance jointly reflects reasoning, grounding, and action execution.
RoboSPA ( Fan et al., 2026 ) further evaluates VLA models on reasoning and procedural planning, but still couples reasoning with low-level execution.
LongAct ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) attempts to reduce the influence of control to better assess planning, yet evaluates complete embodied agents rather than VLMs alone.
Plan-Bench instead decouples embodied action execution and directly evaluates VLMs’ reasoning and planning by constructing a benchmark of 699 questions, providing a lightweight interface for isolating the capabilities required by embodied tasks.
blocks.zh:
最近体现的系统越来越多地使用VLMs(Diao等人,2024年,Diao等人)作为决策者。
Harness VLA (Zhang等人, 2026年), Goal2Skill (刘等人,2026年),HIVLA(杨等人,2026年)等. (Shi等人,2025年.,Li等人,2025年.,Yang等人,2025年c) 采用等级框架,将高层次推理和规划与低层次执行分开.
同时,一些基准已开始在具体环境下评估这些能力。
Embody Bench(Yang等人,2025年b)和RoboCerebra(Han等人,2026年)通过交互任务或分级的VLM-VLA系统来评价体现的代理,其中性能共同反映了推理,定位,和行动执行.
机器人SPA (Fan et al., 2026)进一步评价VLA模型关于推理和程序规划,但仍是夫妇推理,低级执行.
LongAct(Zhu等人,2026年)试图减少控制的影响,以便更好地评估规划,然而评价的是完整的内含剂,而不是单是VLM.
Plan-Bench反之代表了动作执行,直接评价了VLMs的推理和规划,构建了699个问题的基准,提供了一种轻量级的界面,用于隔离包含的任务所需的能力。

blocks.en: 3 Plan-Bench
blocks.zh: 3 计划-奔驰

blocks.en:
We introduce Plan-Bench, a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the reasoning and planning capabilities of VLMs in embodied tasks.
In this section, we first describe the construction pipeline, then present the details of data distribution, and finally introduce the evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了Bench计划,这是一个基准,旨在系统地评价自愿任务说明中的推理和规划能力。
在本节中,我们首先描述施工管道,然后介绍数据分配的细节,最后介绍评价协议.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the Plan-Bench construction pipeline, including capability-driven task definition, dual-source data acquisition, manual annotation, and quality assurance.
blocks.zh: 图2:计划-奔驰施工管道概况,包括能力驱动的任务定义,双源数据采集,人工注释,质量保证.

blocks.en: 3.1 Construction Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.1 建筑管道

blocks.en: To ensure high quality and validity, we adopt a task-driven, multi-stage construction pipeline, as illustrated in Figure 2 . The overall process consists of three stages:
blocks.zh: 为确保高质量和有效性,我们采用了由任务驱动的多阶段施工管道,如图2所示。 整个过程包括三个阶段:

blocks.en:
Capability Taxonomy and Task Definition. We first organize the capabilities required for reasoning and planning in embodied environments into a taxonomy.
The taxonomy comprises three core categories corresponding to Spatial Cognition, Temporal Reasoning, and Multi-Step Planning.
Based on this taxonomy, we further define a set of subtasks, balancing category diversity with task relevance to the targeted capabilities.
This step provides explicit guidance for data acquisition, determining what types of visual evidence and task conditions should be collected or constructed.
blocks.zh:
能力分类和任务定义。 我们首先把在所体现环境中进行推理和规划所需的能力组织成分类。
该分类包括三个核心类别,分别是空间认知、临时理性和多步骤规划。
基于这一分类,我们进一步界定了一套子任务,平衡了类别多样性和与目标能力相关的任务。
这一步骤为获取数据提供了明确的指导,确定了应当收集或构建何种类型的视觉证据和任务条件。

blocks.en:
Dual-Source Data Acquisition. We collect visual data from two sources.
For subclasses requiring precise control over factors such as scene layout and viewpoint, we employ controlled-generation platforms such as Three.js ( Danchilla, 2012 ) and OmniGibson ( Li et al., 2023 ) to configure task-relevant variables for consistent construction.
For those that benefit from more natural visual distributions, we select suitable images from existing datasets such as CLEVR ( Johnson et al., 2017 ) and Captaincook4d ( Peddi et al., 2024 ) , among others ( Yang et al., 2019 , Dai et al., 2026 , Ding et al., 2023 , Lin et al., 2020 ) , to increase visual variety and capture greater real-world scene complexity.
blocks.zh:
双源数据获取. 我们从两个来源收集视觉数据。
对于需要精确控制场景布局和视角等因素的子类,我们使用控制生成平台,如Tree.js(Danchilla,2012年)和OmniGibson(Li等人,2023年)来配置与任务相关的变量,以进行一致的构建.
对于那些受益于更自然的视觉分布的人,我们从CLEVR(Johnson等人,2017年)和Captaincook4d(Peddi等人,2024年)等现有数据集中选择合适的图像. (杨等,2019年;戴等,2026年;丁等,2023年;林等,2020年) 增加视觉多样性,捕捉更多真实世界场景复杂性.

blocks.en:
QA Annotation and Quality Assurance. Based on the acquired images, we manually construct 2,500+ questions and answers according to the task specification of each subclass.
All samples are then independently reviewed by three annotators who are not involved in the initial annotation process.
The review considers answer correctness, image-QA consistency, and relevance to the corresponding task definition.
A sample is accepted only when three reviewers agree that it satisfies all criteria.
Finally, this process yields 699 high-quality questions to construct Plan-Bench.
blocks.zh:
QA 说明和质量保证。 根据获得的图像,我们根据每个子类的任务规格,手动构造2500+问答.
然后,所有样本都由三名不参与初始注释过程的注释员独立审查。
审查考虑了答案正确性、图像-质量评估一致性以及与相应任务定义的相关性。
只有在三名审查人员同意样本符合所有标准时才接受样本。
最后,这一过程产生了699个高质量问题,用于构建奔驰计划。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Illustration of representative samples from the three dimensions of Plan-Bench, including Spatial Cognition, Temporal Reasoning, and Multi-Step Planning.
blocks.zh: 图3:从Plan-Bench的三个方面,包括空间认知、时间理性和多步骤规划,对代表性样本进行说明。

blocks.en: 3.2 Data Distribution
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 数据分布

blocks.en:
Plan-Bench comprises 699 instances, including 183 single-choice questions and 516 open-ended questions.
Our benchmark covers 16 subtasks across three primary categories, providing a comprehensive evaluation of VLMs’ reasoning and planning capabilities in diverse embodied task settings.
Figure 3 presents representative examples from each category in Plan-Bench.
The design motivations and task compositions of these three categories are detailed below:
blocks.zh:
Plan-Bench包括699个实例,包括183个单一选择问题和516个开放式问题。
我们的基准涵盖16个分任务,分三个主要类别,在各种包含的任务环境中,全面评价自愿活动清单的推理和规划能力。
图3列出了Bench计划内每个类别的代表性例子。
这三个类别的设计动机和任务构成如下:

blocks.en:
Spatial Cognition. This category contains 259 instances across six subtasks: Occlusion Order , Mirror Distinction , Action Recovery , Target Discovery , State Recognition , and Spatial Relations .
It is designed to reflect embodied settings where VLMs may observe the same scene through multiple cameras or viewpoints and must integrate these observations to form a coherent understanding of the environment.
It also considers challenging spatial cues such as mirrors and reflections, requiring VLMs to distinguish reflected content from physical entities and reason correctly about the scene.
blocks.zh:
空间认知. 这一类别包含259个案例,涉及6个子任务:隐蔽令、镜像区分、行动恢复、目标发现、国家承认和空间关系。
它旨在反映VLM可以通过多个相机或观点观测同一场景的内在环境,必须综合这些观测结果,形成对环境的一致理解.
它还考虑了镜像和反射等具有挑战性的空间提示,要求VLM将反射的内容与物理实体区分开来,并正确解释场景.

blocks.en:
Temporal Reasoning. This category contains 210 instances across five subtasks: Progress Tracking , Temporal Ordering , Persistent Counting , Instruction Alignment , and Motion Retrieval .
This category includes many egocentric multi-image sequences, designed to reflect embodied tasks such as cooking and navigation, where VLMs must reason over temporally evolving observations from a first-person perspective.
It evaluates whether VLMs can understand temporal dependencies across sequential observations, including ordering events, tracking target actions or states, and identifying recurring objects across frames.
These tasks further assess whether models can preserve relevant historical context and maintain consistent reasoning throughout extended embodied interactions.
blocks.zh:
时间原因 该类包含210个案例,涉及5个子任务:进展跟踪、临时顺序、持续计数、指令对齐和运动检索。
这一类包括许多以自我为中心的多图像序列,旨在反映烹饪和导航等包含的任务,其中VLM必须从第一人称角度解释超时间演化的观测.
它评价VLM是否能够理解连续观测的时间依赖性,包括命令事件,跟踪目标行动或状态,以及确定跨帧的反复出现对象.
这些任务进一步评估模型是否能够保留相关的历史背景,并在整个延伸的内在互动中保持一致的推理。

blocks.en:
Multi-Step Planning. This category contains 230 instances across five subtasks: Constraint Sequencing , Capacity Planning , Rearrangement Planning , Dependency Planning , and Route Planning .
It reflects embodied scenarios where VLMs must first reason about task goals, scene constraints, and action dependencies to produce plans before execution.
It evaluates whether VLMs can translate such information into action sequences toward a target.
Successful planning may indicate the potential of VLMs to serve as more stable high-level decision makers in physical systems.
blocks.zh:
多步规划. 这一类包含230个实例,涉及5个子任务:约束序列、能力规划、重新安排规划、依赖规划和路线规划。
它反映了各种设想,即自愿多数派必须首先说明任务目标、现场限制和行动依赖性,以便在执行之前制定计划。
它评估了VLM是否能够将此类信息转化为面向目标的行动序列.
成功的规划可能表明,自愿终止措施有可能成为实体系统中更稳定的高级别决策者。

Table 1: Comparison of different VLMs on Plan-Bench.
We report performance across the three task categories: Spatial Cognition, Temporal Reasoning, and Multi-Step Planning, together with the overall accuracy.
The best results in each column are bolded.
The random baseline is computed by assigning 0% to open-ended questions and 25% to single-choice questions.
All values are rounded to the nearest tenth of a percentage point and reported as percentages (%).
blocks.zh:
表1:关于Bench计划的各种自愿活动清单的比较。
我们报告三个任务类别的业绩:空间认知、时间理性和多步骤规划,以及总体准确性。
每个栏目的最佳成绩都是大胆的.
随机基线的计算方法是,对开放式问题分配0%,对单一选择问题分配25%。
所有数值均四舍五入到一个百分点的最接近的十分之一,并以百分比报告。

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价议定书

blocks.en:
We evaluate model responses using an LLM-as-judge approach.
Many open-ended questions in Plan-Bench admit multiple valid answers due to equivalent object references, alternative orderings, or other semantically equivalent forms.
To handle such cases, we pair these samples with answer hints that specify additional valid alternatives or equivalence conditions beyond the ground-truth answer, such as valid order swaps, position exchanges, or alternative object names.
DeepSeek-V4-Flash ( Xu et al., 2026a ) serves as the judge, taking the model output, ground-truth answer, and answer hint as input to determine whether the response should be considered correct under these acceptable alternatives.
To validate the reliability of the evaluation process, we randomly sample 200 instances for manual verification, and the judge achieves 100% agreement with human evaluation on these samples.
The full judge prompt is provided in the Appendix B.2 for reproducibility.
blocks.zh:
我们采用LLM即审即决的方法评价示范对策。
Plan-Bench中的许多开放式问题由于对等对象的引用,另类命令,或者其他类聚形式,承认了多种有效的答案.
为了处理这类情况,我们将这些样本配以答案提示,在地面真实答案之外指定其他有效的替代方法或等效条件,例如有效的订单交换、位置交换或替代对象名称。
DeepSeek-V4-Flash(Xu 等人,2026a)担任评委,以模型输出,地面真实答案,回答提示作为投入,以确定这些可接受的替代品下的反应是否应被视为正确.
为了验证评价过程的可靠性,我们随机抽取200例进行人工核查,法官对这些样本的人类评价达成了100%的同意.
附录B.2规定了法官的及时性,以便复制。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
In this section, we present an evaluation of VLMs on Plan-Bench to examine their reasoning and planning capabilities in embodied worlds.
We first introduce the experimental setup, then report the main results on 28 VLMs, and finally provide ablation studies to further investigate model behaviors.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们介绍了对 " 奔驰计划 " 的VLM的评估,以审查它们在所体现世界中的推理和规划能力。
我们首先介绍实验设置,然后报告28个VLM的主要结果,最后提供衰减研究以进一步调查模型行为.

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en:
Models. We evaluate Plan-Bench on a broad suite of 28 VLMs, including 23 open-source models and 5 commercial models.
The evaluated models are generally grouped into four categories according to model scale and deployment setting: (i) lightweight models with around 2B-4B parameters, (ii) middle-scale models with 7B–12B parameters, (iii) larger open-source models, comprising 27B–31B dense models and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, and (iv) commercial frontier models.
For open-source models, we evaluate a diverse set of model families with different architectures, including Qwen3.8 ( Qwen Team, 2026c ) , Qwen3.5 ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) , Qwen3-VL ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , Gemma-4 ( Team et al., 2026a ) , Step3-VL ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , GLM-4.6V ( Hong et al., 2025 ) , InternVL3.5 ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , Ovis ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , SenseNova-U1 ( Diao et al., 2026d ) , NEO ( Diao et al., 2026a ) , and MiMo-VL ( Yue et al., 2025 ) .
For commercial models, we evaluate GPT-5.6-sol ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Kimi-K3 ( Team et al., 2026b ) , Gemini-3.1-pro-preview ( Google, 2026 ) , Claude-Opus-4.8 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , and Qwen3.8-Max ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) .
blocks.zh:
模特儿们 我们用28个VLM(包括23个开源模型和5个商业模型)的宽度包评价Bench计划。
所评价的模型一般按照模型尺度和部署设置分为四类:(一) 重量较轻的模型,有大约2B-4B参数;(二) 中型模型,有7B-12B参数;(三) 较大的开源模型,包括27B-31B密集模型和专家混合模型;(四) 商业前沿模型。
对于开源模型,我们评价了具有不同建筑的一组不同的模范家庭,包括Qune3.8(Qune Team, 2026c),Qune3.5(Qune Team, 2026b),Qune3-VL(Yang等人, 2025a),Gemma-4(Team等人, 2026a),Step3-VL(Huang等人, 2026),GLM-4.6V(Hong等人, 2025),InternVL3.5(Wang等人, 2025b),Ovis(Lu等人,2025),SenseNova-U1(Diao等人, 2026d),近地天体(Diao等人, 2026a),以及MiMo-VL(Yue等人,2025).
对于商业模型,我们评价GPT-5.6-sol(OpenAI,2026),Kimi-K3 (Team et al., 2026b),双子座3.1-pro-review(Google, 2026),克劳德-奥普斯-4.8(Anthropic, 2026),和Qune3.8-Max(Quen Team, 2026a).

blocks.en:
Evaluation. All open-source models are evaluated using VLMEvalKit ( Duan et al., 2024 ) with the default decoding settings from their official repositories, running in BF16 precision on NVIDIA A800 GPUs.
Proprietary models are evaluated through their official APIs under the same protocol.
Further details on the evaluation prompts and model configurations are provided in the Appendix.
blocks.zh:
评价。 所有开源模型都使用VLMEvalKit(Duan等人,2024年)从其官方寄存器中默认解码设置来评价,运行于NVIDIA A800 GPU上的BF16精度.
专有型号通过同一协议下的官方API进行评估.
关于评价提示和模型配置的进一步详情载于附录。

blocks.zh: 图4 Plan-Bench的16个子任务中有8个具有代表性的VLM的精细表现. 每个单元格报告准确性(%),颜色强度显示性能。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Current VLMs show limited reasoning and planning capabilities toward embodied tasks. As shown in Table 1 , current VLMs exhibit room for improvement on Plan-Bench.
Among the 28 evaluated models, Qwen3.8-Max achieves the highest overall accuracy of 75.0%, followed by Kimi-K3 at 70.2%.
All remaining models fall below 70%, including GPT-5.6-sol at 65.8%.
Among the MoE, 7–12B, and 2–4B groups, the best-performing models are Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, Qwen3.5-9B, and Qwen3.5-4B, achieving 49.5%, 49.2%, and 43.2% overall accuracy, respectively.
Beyond these leading models, most of the remaining models in these groups cluster around 20% accuracy, with only a few reaching the high-20% to mid-30% range.
These results indicate that reliable reasoning and planning over physical environments remains far from solved for current VLMs.
blocks.zh:
目前的自愿终止措施表明,对包含的任务的推理和规划能力有限。 如表1所示,VLMs对Bench计划有改进的余地。
在28个被评价的模型中,Qwen3.8-Max达到了75.0%的最高整体精度,其次是Kimi-K3,为70.2%.
其余所有型号都低于70%,包括65.8%的GPT-5.6-溶液.
在教育部,7–12B组和2–4B组中,表现最好的模型是Quen3.5-35B-A3B,Quen3.5-9B,以及Quen3.5-4B,分别实现了49.5%,49.2%和43.2%的总体准确性.
除了这些领先的模型外,这些组中大多数剩余的模型聚集在大约20%的精度上,只有少数模型达到20%至30%的中度。
这些结果表明,对物理环境的可靠推理和规划仍然远远没有解决当前脆弱土地管理问题。

blocks.en:
Spatial cognition remains challenging for current VLMs. As shown in Table 1 , many models stay close to the 10.4% random baseline.
For example, Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct and InternVL3.5-2B achieve only 14.3% and 13.9%, while Qwen3.5-2B scores 15.1%.
This weakness is not confined to the lightweight models, as Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct and NEO-ov reach 17.8% and 18.5%.
Across the full set of evaluated models, only nine models exceed 30% accuracy, while ten remain around or below 20%.
Even among stronger frontier models, the highest accuracy is only 69.5%, achieved by Kimi-K3, followed by Qwen3.8-Max at 66.4%.
These results show that current VLMs still struggle to reliably integrate spatial evidence across multiple viewpoints and complex scene configurations.
blocks.zh:
空间认知对目前的甚高频仍然具有挑战性。 如表1所示,许多模型都接近10.4%。
例如,Quen3-VL-2B-指令和InternVL3.5-2B的成绩只有14.3%和13.9%,而Quen3.5-2B的成绩为15.1%.
这一弱点不仅限于轻量级模型,因为Qune3-VL-8B-指令式和近地物体运载火箭达到17.8%和18.5%。
在整个一套评估模型中,只有9个模型的准确度超过30%,而10个模型的准确度仍然在20%左右。
即使在较强的前沿模型中,最高精度仅为69.5%,由Kimi-K3实现,其次是Qune3.8-Max,为66.4%.
这些结果显示,目前的VLM仍然难以可靠地整合跨多角度和复杂场景配置的空间证据.

blocks.en:
Model scaling generally benefits embodied reasoning and planning. Within the same model family and architecture, performance improves with scale.
Qwen3.5, for example, increases from 20.2% at 2B to 49.2% at 9B and further to 55.9% at 27B.
Similar trends are observed for Gemma-4 and InternVL3.5.
Gemma-4 improves from 28.5% at 12B to 43.5% at 31B, while InternVL3.5 rises from 12.6% at 2B to 19.6% at 8B.
However, this relationship is not consistent across model families.
Qwen3.8-27B reaches 62.2%, higher than Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview at 46.4%.
Similarly, Qwen3.5-9B achieves 49.2%, outperforming the much larger Gemma-4-31B at 43.5%.
Overall, larger models tend to perform better, while architecture and training strategy also remain important factors.
blocks.zh:
模型的扩大一般都体现了推理和规划。 在同一模式家庭和建筑中,业绩随着规模的提高而提高。
例如,Wen3.5从2B的20.2%增至9B的49.2%,再增至27B的55.9%。
Gemma-4和InternVL3.5也有类似的趋势。
Gemma-4从12B的28.5%提高到31B的43.5%,而InternVL3.5则从2B的12.6%上升到8B的19.6%.
然而,在模范家庭中,这种关系并不一致。
Quen3.8-27B达到62.2%,高于双子座3.1-Pro-Preview的46.4%.
同样,Quen3.5-9B的成绩为49.2%,比Gemma-4-31B大得多的43.5%。
总的来说,较大的模式往往表现更好,而建筑和培训战略也仍然是重要因素。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en:
Strong overall performance does not imply consistent fine-grained capabilities. Figure 4 reveals variation across the 16 subtasks.
Even the strongest models exhibit weaknesses on individual tasks.
Qwen3.8-Max, for example, exceeds 70% accuracy on several subtasks but reaches only 38.0% on Persistent Counting, while Kimi-K3 drops to 10.0% on Rearrangement Planning despite strong performance elsewhere.
Models with similar overall accuracy may still differ across tasks.
Qwen3.5-2B and Ovis2.5-9B achieve comparable overall scores, yet differ considerably across Progress Tracking, Spatial Relations, Constraint Sequencing, and Capacity Planning.
Overall, strong or similar aggregate performance can still coexist with task-specific weaknesses and capability differences.
blocks.zh:
强有力的总体业绩并不意味着一贯的精细能力。 图4显示16个次级任务的差异。
即使最强的模型也显示出个别任务的弱点。
例如,Qwen3.8-Max在几个子任务上超过了70%的精度,但在持续计数上却只达到38.0%,而Kimi-K3在重排规划上则下降至10.0%,尽管其他地方表现强劲.
总体准确性类似的模型可能因任务而异。
Quen3.5-2B和Ovis2.5-9B的总得分相当,但在进度跟踪、空间关系、约束序列和能力规划方面却有很大不同。
总体而言,强劲或类似的总体业绩仍然可以与具体任务的弱点和能力差异共存。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Robustness to Increasing Misleading Views across Model Scales.
blocks.zh: 图5 在整个示范规模中增强误导观点的能力。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Navigation and Manipulation Performance across Different Models.
blocks.zh: 图6:不同模型的导航和操纵性能。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Comparison between Thinking and Non-Thinking modes on Plan-Bench across Spatial Cognition, Temporal Reasoning, Multi-Step Planning, and overall accuracy. Blue and orange markers denote Thinking and Non-Thinking results, while the annotated values indicate their gaps.
blocks.zh: 图7:跨空间认知、时间理性、多步骤规划以及总体准确性的Plan-Bench思维模式和非思维模式的比较。 蓝色和橙色标记表示思考和非思考的结果,而附加说明的数值则表示其差距.

blocks.en:
More views do not necessarily lead to better spatial cognition. Current VLMs remain susceptible to interference from misleading viewpoints.
We reorganize Spatial Relations under the Spatial Cognition dimension into three settings: 1 right, 1 right + 2 mislead, and 1 right + 4 mislead, where additional views contain misleading cues.
The results in Figure 6 show that all seven models perform well when only the informative view is provided, but their accuracy consistently declines as more misleading views are introduced.
Larger models generally show greater robustness to such distractions.
Qwen3.8-27B drops from 90.9% to 68.2%, while Qwen3.5-2B falls from 93.2% to 22.7%.
Yet scale alone does not explain this robustness, as Gemma-4-31B-it is less robust than the smaller Qwen3.5-9B, suggesting that model architecture and training strategy may also play important roles.
blocks.zh:
更多的观点并不一定导致空间认知的改善. 目前的自愿终止措施仍然容易受到误导观点的干扰。
我们把空间认知维度下的空间关系重组为三个环境:一个是右方,一个是右方+二方误导,另一个是右方+四方误导,其中其他观点含有误导提示。
图6的结果显示,所有七个模型在只提供资料性观点时都表现良好,但其准确性随着更误导性观点的引入而持续下降。
较大型的模型通常显示出这种分散注意力的更强健性。
文选3.8-27 B从90.9%下降到68.2%,而Quen3.5-2B则从93.2%下降到22.7%。
然而,规模本身并不能解释这种稳健性,因为Gemma-4-31B-它的稳健性不如较小的Quen3.5-9B,这表明模型架构和培训战略也可能发挥重要作用.

blocks.en:
Thinking improves performance, with the largest gains in multi-step planning. We compare ten models that support both Thinking and Non-Thinking modes on Plan-Bench.
As shown in Figure 7 , Thinking improves nearly all dimension-level and overall results, with the only exception of Qwen3.5-2B, which drops by 1.5 percentage points on Spatial Cognition.
Among the three dimensions, Thinking brings the largest gains on Multi-Step Planning, with an average improvement of 31.1 percentage points, compared with 19.4 on Temporal Reasoning and 15.2 on Spatial Cognition.
At the overall level, all models benefit from Thinking, with improvements ranging from 4.9 percentage points on Gemma-4-12B-it to 32.6 points on Kimi-K3.
Despite longer inference time, Thinking enables models to better handle reasoning and planning tasks in embodied environments.
blocks.zh:
思考能提高绩效,在多步骤规划中收获最大. 我们比较了十个模式 支持思考模式和非思考模式 在Plan-Bench。
如图7所示,思维几乎改善了所有维度水平和总体结果,唯一的例外是Quen3.5-2B,在空间认知方面下降了1.5个百分点。
在三个层面中, 思维在多步骤规划方面带来最大的收益,平均提高31.1个百分点,而临时理性和空间认知则分别是19.4和15.2。
总体来说,所有模型都得益于"思考",改进幅度从Gemma-4-12B-it的4.9个百分点到Kimi-K3的32.6个百分点不等.
尽管推论时间更长,但思考可以使模型在所体现环境中更好地处理推理和规划任务.

blocks.en:
Navigation and Manipulation are broadly aligned, with model-specific mismatches. We group Plan-Bench into Navigation-related ( Route Planning, Instruction Alignment, and Target Discovery ) and Manipulation-related ( Dependency Planning, Constraint Sequencing, and Occlusion Order ).
As shown in Figure 6 , most models exhibit similar trends.
For example, Qwen3.8-Max, Kimi-K3, and GPT-5.6-sol show balanced performance on the two task groups.
However, some models exhibit biases, with Qwen3.8-27B achieving about 69.3% on Manipulation task but 54.6% on Navigation task, while Step3-VL-10B shows a gap of roughly 15 percentage points.
These results further indicate that larger models have greater potential to serve as high-level decision makers in physical environments, with more stable and consistent performance across diverse embodied tasks.
blocks.zh:
导航和操纵大致对齐,有模型特定的不匹配. 我们把Bench计划分为与导航有关的(路线规划、指令协调和目标发现)和与操纵有关的(依赖规划、约束序列和占领令)。
如图6所示,大多数模型呈现出类似趋势。
例如,Qune3.8-Max,Kimi-K3和GPT-5.6-sol在两个任务组表现出平衡的表现.
然而,有些模型表现出偏颇,Qune3.8-27B在操纵任务上达到了约69.3%,而在导航任务上达到了54.6%,而Step3-VL-10B显示差距约为15个百分点.
这些结果进一步表明,较大的模型具有更大的潜力,可作为物理环境中的高级别决策者,在各种包含的任务中具有更加稳定和一致的业绩。

blocks.en:
Hallucination is a source of reasoning and planning errors in the embodied world. We analyze Qwen3.8-Max, the best-performing model on Plan-Bench, focusing on failures in Mirror Distinction, Persistent Counting, and Target Discovery .
As shown in Figure 8 , the model fails to distinguish real objects from their reflections in Mirror Distinction , hallucinating reflections as physical entities.
In Persistent Counting , it incorrectly associates two distinct objects across views due to similar surrounding landmarks, resulting in an incorrect match.
A similar phenomenon also appears in Target Discovery .
This suggests that failures arise not only from visual recognition errors, but also from hallucinations during high-level reasoning and multi-step planning.
Reducing such hallucinations may be important for improving the reliability of VLMs in embodied reasoning and planning.
blocks.zh:
幻觉是所体现世界中推理和规划错误的来源. 我们分析Qune3.8-Max, Plan-Bench上表现最好的模型,
如图8所示,该模型未能区分真实物体与它们在镜像区分中的反射,幻觉反射为物理实体.
在《持续计数》中,由于周围的地标相似,它错误地将两个不同的对象连接在一起,导致不正确的匹配。
类似现象也出现在目标发现中。
这表明失败不仅产生于视觉识别错误,而且也产生于高层推理和多步骤规划过程中的幻觉.
减少这种幻觉对于提高虚拟LM在体现的推理和规划中的可靠性可能很重要。

blocks.zh: 图8: Qune3.8-Max制作的幻觉错误的代表实例

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和讨论

blocks.en:
We construct Plan-Bench to evaluate the reasoning and planning capabilities of VLMs in embodied tasks across Spatial Cognition, Temporal Reasoning, and Multi-step Planning, while several limitations remain to be further explored and addressed. (i) Continually evolving frontier models. Although we have evaluated diverse models, frontier systems evolve rapidly and performance may change across versions.
Future work will track newly released models to assess progress in these capabilities. (ii) Limited data scale and task coverage. Plan-Bench includes 699 samples across 16 subcategories, while there is still room to expand both the dataset scale and task diversity.
Further expansion will enable a more comprehensive evaluation of reasoning and planning. (iii) Potential errors in LLM-as-judge. Our LLM-as-judge achieves 100% agreement with human evaluation on 200 sampled cases, but some errors may still exist in the remaining samples.
We will further explore more robust and programmatic evaluation procedures to improve evaluation accuracy and reliability.
blocks.zh:
我们构建了Bench计划,以评价在空间认知、时间理性和多步骤规划等包含的各项任务中,虚拟LM的推理和规划能力,而若干局限性仍有待进一步探讨和解决。 (i) 不断演变的前沿模式。 虽然我们评价了不同的模型,但前沿系统发展迅速,各版本的性能可能发生变化。
今后的工作将跟踪新发布的模型,以评估这些能力的进展情况。 (二) 数据规模和任务覆盖面有限。 Plan-Bench包含699个样本,涉及16个亚类,同时仍有扩展数据集尺度和任务多样性的空间.
进一步扩大范围将有助于更全面地评价推理和规划。 (三) LM-as-judge的潜在错误。 我们的LLM即时法官对200个抽样案例的人类评价达成了100%的一致,但剩余样本中可能仍然存在一些错误.
我们将进一步探讨更强有力的方案评价程序,以提高评价的准确性和可靠性。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce Plan-Bench, a lightweight and systematic benchmark for evaluating the high-level reasoning and multi-step planning capabilities of VLMs in embodied scenarios independently of action execution.
Plan-Bench covers Spatial Cognition, Temporal Reasoning, and Multi-Step Planning, spanning 16 subclasses and 699 curated samples.
Evaluation of 28 VLMs shows that current models still have room for improvement, with the best-performing model achieving only 75.0% accuracy.
Ablation studies further reveal that strong overall performance does not guarantee consistent capabilities across subtasks, and that models remain sensitive to misleading evidence and prone to hallucinations during reasoning.
We also find that scaling generally improves results, while architecture and training may also influence performance, with Thinking bringing additional gains, particularly for Multi-Step Planning.
Our results suggest that larger VLMs show greater potential as high-level planners, but reliable reasoning and planning across diverse embodied tasks remain challenging.
Overall, Plan-Bench provides a principled and easy-to-deploy testbed for tracking progress in these capabilities and assessing VLMs as high-level decision makers for embodied AI.

Plan-Bench涵盖空间认知、临时理性和多步骤规划,涵盖16个子类和699个经整理的样本。
对28个VLM的评价表明,目前的模型仍有改进的余地,最佳的模型只有75.0%的准确度.
疏导研究进一步揭示,强力的整体性能并不能保证各子任务的能力一致,模型对误导性证据仍然敏感,在推理过程中容易产生幻觉.
我们还发现,规模的扩大一般能改善成果,而结构和培训也可能影响业绩,思维带来额外收益,特别是在多步骤规划方面。
我们的结果表明,规模较大的自愿活动说明,作为高级别规划者,潜力更大,但涉及各种具体任务的可靠推理和规划仍然具有挑战性。

blocks.en: Appendix A Benchmark Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 基准细节

blocks.en: A.1 Task Definitions
blocks.zh: A.1 任务定义

blocks.en:
Plan-Bench consists of 16 subtasks that instantiate different reasoning and planning challenges in embodied scenarios.
Below, we provide detailed definitions of each subtask and clarify the specific capability evaluated by each task.
blocks.zh:
Plan-Bench由16个子任务组成,在包含的各种情景中即时提出不同的推理和规划挑战.
下面,我们提供每个子任务的详细定义,并澄清每项任务所评价的具体能力。

blocks.en:
Occlusion Order (OO). Given a scene containing partially occluded objects, the model is required to infer their relative ordering from visual occlusion cues.
This task evaluates whether the model can reason about object ordering when complete object boundaries are not directly observable.
blocks.zh:
闭塞令(OO). 鉴于一个包含部分被占用物体的场景,该模型需要从视觉隔离提示推断它们的相对订单.
此任务评价当完全对象边界无法直接观察到时,模型是否能够对对象顺序进行解释.

blocks.en:
Mirror Distinction (MD). The model must distinguish real objects from their reflections and correctly reason about the scene content.
The task is designed to evaluate whether the model can distinguish real objects from reflections and correctly handle reflection-induced visual ambiguity.
blocks.zh:
明镜区分 (MD). 该模型必须区分真实物体与它们的反射,并正确解释场景内容.
任务旨在评价模型是否能够区分真实物体与反射,并正确处理反射引起的视觉模糊.

blocks.en:
Action Recovery (AR). Given partial information from one viewpoint, the model is asked to recover the corresponding information that is missing or unclear from another viewpoint.
This task examines whether the model can compare observations across multiple views and integrate complementary visual cues to reconstruct the complete scene information.
blocks.zh:
行动恢复(AR). 鉴于从一种观点得到的部分信息,要求该模型从另一种观点中收回缺失或不明确的相应信息。
这项任务审查该模型是否能够比较多种观点的观察,并整合互补的视觉提示以重建完整的场景信息.

blocks.en:
Target Discovery (TD). The model must reason about the target’s spatial relationship under mirror reflections and plan a feasible path toward it.
This task evaluates spatial reasoning and path planning in reflection-ambiguous scenes.
blocks.zh:
目标发现(TD). 这个模型必须说明目标在反射镜下的空间关系,并计划一条可行的路径。
这项任务评价了反射-矛盾场景中的空间推理和路径规划.

blocks.en:
State Recognition (SR). Given multiple visual observations of a scene, the model must integrate information while identifying redundantly observed content.
This task evaluates multi-view scene understanding and the ability to distinguish new evidence from repeated information.
blocks.zh:
国家承认(SR)。 鉴于对一个场景的多重视觉观察,模型必须整合信息,同时识别多余的观测内容.
这一任务评价了多视图场景的理解和区分新证据与重复信息的能力.

blocks.en:
Spatial Relations (SpR). The model must infer spatial relationships between specified entities from one or multiple views.
The task evaluates spatial reasoning and the ability to integrate relevant evidence while ignoring misleading observations.
blocks.zh:
空间关系 (SpR). 该模型必须从一个或多个角度推断特定实体之间的空间关系。
任务评价空间推理和整合相关证据的能力,同时忽略误导性观察.

blocks.en:
Progress Tracking (PT). Given a sequence depicting an ongoing activity, the model is required to determine the current progress or stage of the activity.
This task evaluates whether the model can track how an embodied procedure evolves over time.
blocks.zh:
进展跟踪(PT). 鉴于一个描述正在进行的活动的序列,需要该模型来确定活动目前的进度或阶段。
这项任务评价模型是否能够跟踪一个包含的程序如何随着时间演变。

blocks.en:
Temporal Ordering (TO). The model must determine the correct temporal order of events, actions, or scene states from sequential visual evidence.
The task evaluates the ability to recover temporal dependencies and distinguish earlier events from later ones.
blocks.zh:
时序(TO). 模型必须从相继的视觉证据中确定事件,动作或场景状态的正确时间顺序.
任务评价了恢复时间依赖性的能力,并区分了早先的事件和后来的事件.

blocks.en:
Persistent Counting (PC). The model is asked to count target entities across a visual sequence while maintaining their identity over time.
This task evaluates whether the model can accumulate information across frames without repeatedly counting the same persistent entity.
blocks.zh:
持续计数(PC). 该模型被要求计算一个视觉序列中的目标实体,同时随着时间的推移保持其身份。
这项任务评价模型是否能够在不重复计算同一持久性实体的情况下跨框架积累信息.

blocks.en:
Instruction Alignment (IA). Given an instruction together with a sequence of visual observations, the model must identify the observation that corresponds to the specified instruction.
The task evaluates the alignment between language-described actions and their visual realization over time.
blocks.zh:
指令对齐(IA). 鉴于一个指令加上一系列的视觉观测,模型必须确定与指定指令对应的观测.
任务评价了语言描述的动作与其随时间推移的视觉实现之间的一致.

blocks.en:
Motion Retrieval (MR). The model is required to identify the motion or action segment that matches a specified query from a temporal sequence.
This task evaluates whether the model can recognize and retrieve task-relevant motion patterns among multiple observed actions.
blocks.zh:
运动检索 (MR). 需要该模型来识别从时间序列中匹配特定查询的运动或动作段.
这项任务评价了该模型是否能够识别并检索在多个观察到的动作中与任务相关的运动模式.

blocks.en:
Constraint Sequencing (CS). Given a set of actions together with ordering constraints, the model must construct a valid action sequence satisfying all specified constraints.
The task evaluates multi-step planning under explicit requirements on the relative order of actions.
blocks.zh:
约束序列(CS). 鉴于一系列行动以及顺序限制,模型必须构建一个满足所有特定限制的有效行动序列。
这项任务根据行动顺序的明确要求评价多步骤规划。

blocks.en:
Capacity Planning (CP). The model is required to produce a feasible plan under capacity limitations on containers or other task-relevant entities.
This task evaluates whether the model can jointly reason about action ordering and limited capacity when constructing a multi-step solution.
blocks.zh:
能力规划。 要求该模型在集装箱或其他与任务有关的实体的能力限制下制定可行的计划。
这项任务评价模型在构建一个多步骤解决方案时是否能够共同说明行动顺序和有限的能力。

blocks.en:
Rearrangement Planning (RP). Given an initial and a target configuration, the model must determine a sequence of actions that transforms the scene into the desired arrangement.
The task evaluates planning capabilities and the consequences of successive rearrangement operations.
blocks.zh:
重新安排规划(RP). 鉴于初始配置和目标配置,模型必须确定将场景转化为理想安排的动作序列.
这项任务评价规划能力和连续重新安排行动的后果。

Dependency Planning (DP). The model must construct an action plan while respecting prerequisite relations among actions or subgoals.
This task evaluates whether the model can identify dependencies and ensure that required preconditions are satisfied before executing dependent actions.
blocks.zh:
依赖性规划。 该模式必须制定行动计划,同时尊重行动或次级目标之间的先决条件关系。
这项任务评价模型是否能够确定依赖性,并确保在执行依赖性行动之前满足必要的先决条件。

blocks.en:
Route Planning (Route). Given spatial information about an environment, the model must determine a feasible route from the current location to a specified destination.
The task evaluates multi-step navigation planning under spatial connectivity, obstacle, and path-feasibility constraints.
blocks.zh:
路线规划 (鲁特). 鉴于环境的空间信息,模型必须确定从目前地点到指定目的地的可行路线。
该任务评价空间连通性、障碍和路径可行性限制下的多步骤导航规划。

blocks.en: A.2 Dataset Statistics
blocks.zh: A.2 数据集统计

blocks.en:
Plan-Bench maintains a balanced distribution across dimensions and subtasks. As shown in Figure 9 , Plan-Bench contains 699 samples distributed across three dimensions, with 259 samples for Spatial Cognition, 210 for Temporal Reasoning, and 230 for Multi-Step Planning.
The samples are further distributed across 16 subtasks, with most subtasks containing between 30 and 50 instances.
Overall, the benchmark maintains a relatively balanced distribution across both dimensions and subtasks, avoiding excessive concentration on any single capability.
blocks.zh:
Plan-Bench在各个层面和次级任务之间保持均衡分布。 如图9所示,Plan-Bench包含分布在三个维度的699个样本,其中259个样本用于空间认知,210个样本用于时间理性,230个样本用于多步骤规划。
样本进一步分布在16个子任务中,大多数子任务包含30至50个实例.
总体而言,该基准在各层面和次级任务之间保持相对均衡的分布,避免过度集中于任何单一能力。

blocks.en:
Plan-Bench exhibits diversity in visual inputs. As shown in Tables 4 and 4 , the benchmark covers samples containing from 1 to 16 images, with 64.9% of the samples involving multiple images and 47.2% containing six or more images.
The 3,007 images also span a wide range of resolutions, from below 0.5 MP to above 4 MP, with 35.8% exceeding 1 MP.
These statistics highlight the diversity of Plan-Bench in both visual context length and image resolution, rather than relying on a fixed input configuration.

Plan-Bench显示视觉投入的多样性。 如表4和表4所示,基准涵盖包含1至16个图像的样本,其中64.9%涉及多个图像,47.2%包含6个或更多图像。
3,007幅图像也横跨了广泛的决议,从不到0.5 MP到超过4 MP,35.8%超过1 MP.
这些统计数据突出了Plan-Bench在视觉上下文长度和图像分辨率上的多样性,而不是依赖于固定的输入配置.

blocks.en: A.4 Data Sources
blocks.zh: A.4 数据来源

blocks.en:
Plan-Bench combines diverse data sources and question formats across subtasks. As shown in Table 2 , the 16 subtasks are constructed from a mixture of existing datasets, controlled generation tools, simulation environments, and web-sourced data.
Different sources are selected according to the capability targeted by each subtask, ranging from temporal activities to spatial reasoning and multi-step planning.
The benchmark also includes single-choice, open-ended, and mixed-format subtasks, providing diverse evaluation settings rather than relying on a uniform question format.
blocks.zh:
Plan-Bench将不同的数据源和问题格式结合到各子任务中. 如表2所示,16个子任务是由现有数据集、受控生成工具、模拟环境和网络来源数据混合而成的。
根据每个子任务的目标能力选择不同的来源,从时间活动到空间推理和多步骤规划.
基准还包括单一选择、开放式和混合格式子任务,提供不同的评价设置,而不是依赖统一的提问格式。

blocks.en: Appendix B Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录B 评价议定书

blocks.en: B.1 Model Prompt Templates
blocks.zh: B.1 模型快速模板

blocks.en:
Since Plan-Bench contains both single-choice and open-ended questions, we implement a unified prompting function to support both question types within the same evaluation pipeline.
As shown below, all samples share a common Base Prompt , which specifies the general response behavior and output requirements.
We then append a question-type-specific instruction according to the sample format: the Single-Choice Prompt requires the model to return only one option letter, while the Open-Ended Prompt requires only the requested structured answer.
This design provides a consistent prompting framework while preserving the output requirements of different question types.
blocks.zh:
由于 " 奔驰计划 " 既包含单一选择的问题,也包含开放式问题,因此我们执行一个统一的提示功能,在同一评价程序内支持这两种问题类型。
如以下所示,所有样本都共享一个共同的Base Express .,其中具体规定了一般反应行为和输出要求.
然后,我们根据样本格式附加一个特定问题类型的指令: 单选择提示只要求模型返回一个选项字母,而不限时提示只要求所要求的结构化答案.
这种设计提供了一个一致的提示框架,同时保留不同问题类型的输出要求.

blocks.en:
Base Prompt Answer directly. Do not explain your reasoning.
For single-choice questions, answer with one option letter only, such as A.
For open questions, follow the required answer format exactly.

对于单选题,只用一个选项字母回答,如A.
对于未回答的问题,要严格遵循所要求的答案格式。

blocks.en: B.2 LLM-as-Judge Prompt
blocks.zh: B.2 LLM 即时法官

blocks.en:
We use DeepSeek-V4-Flash as an LLM-based judge to evaluate model responses.
For each sample, the judge receives the model output, ground-truth answer, and an optional answer hint specifying additional valid alternatives or equivalence conditions.
A response is labeled True when it is semantically equivalent to the ground-truth answer or satisfies an equivalence condition explicitly defined by the answer hint; otherwise, it is labeled False .
The judge is instructed to evaluate only answer correctness and to return no additional explanation.
blocks.zh:
我们使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash作为基于LLM的法官,来评价模型响应.
对于每个样本,法官都会收到模型输出,地面真实答案,以及一个可选的答案提示,具体指明额外的有效替代品或等效条件.
当答复与地面真实答案或满足由答案提示明确定义的等同条件时,其名称为True;否则,其名称为False。
法官奉命只评价回答正确性,不回复补充解释.

blocks.en:
System Prompt (Answer Equivalence Judge) You are a precise answer-equivalence judge for evaluating model responses. Your task is to determine whether a model output should be considered correct with respect to the ground-truth answer and the provided answer hint. The ground-truth answer specifies the reference answer, while the answer hint provides additional valid alternatives or equivalence conditions that should be accepted. Judge the model output according to the following rules: 1. Semantic Equivalence: Return True if the model output expresses the same answer
as the ground-truth answer, even if the wording or formatting differs. 2. Answer-Hint Equivalence: Return True if the model output satisfies any valid
alternative or equivalence condition explicitly specified in the
answer hint, including acceptable order swaps, position exchanges,
alternative object names, or equivalent action descriptions. 3. Partial Correctness: Return False if the response is only partially correct,
omits required information, or contains an incorrect component. 4. Contradictory or Additional Content: Return False if the response contains information that
contradicts the ground-truth answer or violates the conditions
specified by the answer hint. 5. Formatting Differences: Ignore superficial differences in capitalization, punctuation,
spacing, or other formatting when they do not change the meaning
of the answer. Do not introduce alternative interpretations beyond those supported by the ground-truth answer and answer hint.
Do not infer missing information.

blocks.en: B.3 Answer Hint and Equivalence Rules

blocks.en:
Answer hints handle multiple valid answers in open-ended questions. Among the open-ended questions in Plan-Bench, 486 samples require answer hints across 13 subcategories, including Occlusion Order , Mirror Distinction , State Recognition , Rearrangement Planning , and Dependency Planning .
These hints specify valid equivalence conditions beyond the reference answer, such as interchangeable object references, flexible orderings, position exchanges, and equivalent action sequences.
As illustrated in Figure 10 , the answer hint is provided only to the LLM judge, allowing semantically equivalent predictions to be accepted without exposing additional information to the evaluated model.

解答提示处理开放式问题中的多个有效解答. 在Plan-Bench的开放式问题中,有486个样本需要13个亚类的解答提示,包括:Occusion Order, Mirror Division, State Admination,Rearposition Planning, 和依赖性规划。
这些提示指定了参考答案以外的有效等效条件,如可互换对象引用,灵活命令,位置交换,以及等效动作序列.
如图10所示,只向LLM法官提供答案提示,允许接受模拟等同的预测,而不向被评价的模型披露更多信息。

blocks.en: B.4 Human Verification of the Judge
blocks.zh: B.4 法官的人道核查

blocks.en:
To further assess the reliability of our LLM-based evaluation, we conduct a human verification study on 200 responses generated by Qwen3.8-Max, Gemma-4-31B-it, and Step3-VL-10B.
We adopt stratified sampling to ensure diverse and balanced coverage across the three evaluation dimensions and their corresponding subclasses, selecting 67 samples from Spatial Cognition , 67 from Temporal Reasoning , and 66 from Multi-Step Planning .
Among the 200 sampled instances, 133 contain answer hints specifying acceptable alternatives or equivalence conditions, such as alternative object names, interchangeable orderings, or equivalent action sequences, while the remaining 67 have no answer hints.
All 200 responses are independently evaluated by human annotators and DeepSeek-V4-Flash based on the same ground-truth answers and answer hints.
The two evaluations agree on all 200 samples, achieving 100% agreement, including the 133 cases involving answer hints.
These results demonstrate that our LLM-based judge can reliably account for equivalent valid answers and provide consistent evaluation for Plan-Bench.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步评估我们基于LLM的评价的可靠性,我们对Qune3.8-Max、Gemma-4-31B-it和Step3-VL-10B生成的200个答复进行了人类核查研究。
我们采用分层抽样,以确保在三个评价层面及其相应的子类中进行多样化和均衡的覆盖,从空间认知中选择67个样本,从临时理性中选择67个样本,从多步骤规划中选择66个样本。
在200个抽样实例中,133个载有回答提示,具体说明可接受的替代或等效条件,如替代对象名称,可互换命令,或等效动作序列,其余67个则没有回答提示.
所有200个回复都由人类注释员和DeepSeek-V4-Flash根据同样的地面真实答案和回答提示进行独立评价.
两项评价商定了全部200个样本,达成了100%的协议,包括涉及回答提示的133个案例。
这些结果显示,我们基于LLM的法官能够可靠地说明同等有效的答案,并为Plan-Bench提供一致的评价.

blocks.en: C.1 Results on All 16 Subtasks
blocks.zh: C.1 所有16个次级任务的成果

blocks.en:
Tables 9 – 10 report model accuracy on all 16 subtasks of Plan-Bench, revealing differences that are hidden by the three dimension-level scores.
In Spatial Cognition, GPT-5.6-sol achieves 82.9% on Mirror Distinction and 87.5% on State Recognition, but only 30.0% on Target Discovery and 31.3% on Spatial Relations.
Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview shows a contrasting profile, reaching 75.0% on Spatial Relations but only 22.0% on Occlusion Order.
Qwen3.5-27B also varies sharply across the category, with 56.8% on Spatial Relations but 18.0% on Occlusion Order.
These contrasts indicate that success on one form of spatial evidence does not reliably extend to the other visual reasoning demands within the same dimension, even when the tasks draw on similar visual scenes and viewpoints that expose different but complementary scene cues about object locations.
blocks.zh:
表9 – Plan-Bench所有16个子任务的10个报告模型精度,揭示了三个维度级分数所隐藏的差异.
在空间认知方面,GPT-5.6-sol在镜像区分方面达到82.9%,在国家识别方面达到87.5%,但在目标发现方面只有30.0%,在空间关系方面只有31.3%。
双子座3.1-Pro-Preview显示一个对比性剖面,在空间关系上达到75.0%,但在Occulusion Order上只有22.0%.
文3.5-27 (中文(简体) ). 乙级 不同类别的情况也大不相同,在空间关系方面为56.8%,在占领令方面为18.0%。
这些对比表明,在一种空间证据形式上的成功并不能可靠地扩展到同一维度内的其他视觉推理需求,即使这些任务借鉴了类似的视觉场景和观点,暴露了不同但互补的关于物体位置的场景提示.

blocks.en:
Temporal Reasoning likewise exhibits substantial variation between subtasks.
Qwen3.5-27B achieves 96.7% on Progress Tracking and 80.0% on Temporal Ordering, but only 28.0% on Persistent Counting.
GPT-5.6-sol follows a similar pattern, scoring 93.3% on Progress Tracking and 30.0% on Persistent Counting.
Even Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, which reaches 40.0% on Persistent Counting, performs much better on Progress Tracking at 86.7%.
These gaps suggest that inferring task progress and event order is easier for these models than maintaining accurate counts when objects or actions recur across visual sequences and must be distinguished from previous observations or distractors that appear between relevant activity steps in multi-frame observations.
blocks.zh:
同样,临时理由表明,各分任务之间也有很大差异。
Quen3.5-27B在进度跟踪方面达到96.7%,在时间顺序方面达到80.0%,但在持续计数方面只达到28.0%.
GPT-5.6-sol遵循类似的模式,在进度跟踪上得分93.3%,在持续计数上得分30.0%.
即使Quen3.5-35B-A3B在持续计数方面达到40.0%,在86.7%的进展跟踪方面表现也好得多。
这些空白表明,推断任务进展和事件顺序对于这些模型来说比在物体或行动跨视觉序列重现时保持准确的计数更容易,必须区别于在多框架观测中相关活动步骤之间出现的先前的观测或分心器.

blocks.en:
In Multi-Step Planning, strong results on one type of constraint do not consistently transfer to other planning problems.
Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview scores 93.3% on Capacity Planning but only 10.0% on Rearrangement Planning.
Similarly, Qwen3.5-27B scores 90.0% on Capacity Planning but 44.0% on Route Planning.
Rearrangement Planning is particularly difficult for several smaller models: InternVL3.5-8B and NEO-9B-SFT both score 0.0% despite obtaining 30.0% and 53.3% on Capacity Planning, respectively.
Thus, the detailed results expose task-specific weaknesses in spatial reasoning, temporal tracking, and multi-step planning that aggregate accuracy cannot capture.
blocks.zh:
在 " 多阶段规划 " 中,对一种制约的有力结果不能一贯地转移到其他规划问题上。
双子座3.1-预检分数93.3% 计划,但只有10.0%的重新安排计划。
同样,Quen3.5-27B在能力规划方面得分90.0%,在路线规划方面得分44.0%。
重新安排 对几个较小的模型进行规划特别困难:INNVL3.5-8B和近地物体-9B-SFT均得分0.0,尽管在能力规划方面分别获得30.0%和53.3%。
因此,详细的结果暴露了空间推理、时间跟踪和多步骤规划中针对具体任务的弱点,而总体准确性无法捕捉这些弱点。

blocks.en: C.2 Additional Error Analysis
blocks.zh: C.2 其他错误分析

blocks.en: Figure 10 presents two additional Target Discovery failures by Qwen3.8-Max. In both cases, the target appears in a mirror, so selecting the correct action requires the model to associate the reflection with a real object and infer that object’s location. In the first example, the model notices the similarity between the reflected picture and the directly visible picture, but speculates that another identical picture exists elsewhere. It therefore selects an action that leads away from the actual target. In the second example, the model likewise treats the reflected and visible paper towel dispensers as two separate objects, incorrectly concluding that the target is behind the camera.
blocks.zh: 图10按Qune3.8-Max列出了另外两个目标发现失败. 在这两种情况下,目标都出现在镜像中,所以选择正确的动作需要模型将反射与真实对象联系起来,并推断该对象的位置. 在第一个例子中,模型注意到反射的图片和直接可见的图片的相似性,但推测在别处存在另一个相同的图片. 因此,它选择了一个偏离实际目标的行动。 在第二个例子中,模型同样将反射和可见的纸巾喷射器作为两个独立的物体,错误地断定目标在镜头后面.

blocks.en: These examples show how hallucination can arise when the model fails to establish the correspondence between a reflection and a physical object. Although it recognizes their visual similarity, it hallucinates a second, identical object and reasons about its nonexistent location. This mistaken interpretation then leads to an incorrect navigation decision, showing how object hallucination can propagate from scene understanding to action planning in Target Discovery.
blocks.zh: 这些例子表明当模型未能确定反射与物理物体之间的对应时,幻觉是如何产生的. 虽然它承认它们的视觉相似性,但它却幻觉了第二个,相同的物体以及它不存在的原因. 这种错误的解释随后导致了不正确的导航决定,显示物体幻觉如何从场景理解传播到目标发现中的行动规划.
